question: How much paired-angle friction and load response can a shared passive first-harmonic material law explain without a UD-specific source?
assumptions: one-dimensional periodic sinusoidal PES cut and prescribed steady x=vt
one passive overdamped mode q with kappa>0,eta>=0 and assumed lambda
physical_mapping: per upper atom drag coefficient derived in physical units, but contact transfer and UD attribution OPEN

known_targets: paired 21.8/38.2 degree detectable peaks and negligible load slope
fitted_choices: single passive q benchmark chosen for simplicity, no measured force fit
single-mode conventional null selected as benchmark, no kinetic fit
baseline: rigid DFT first-harmonic static shear and conventional passive relaxation
result: Exact passive single-mode drag and pressure slope. Under additional shared bath assumptions the source-rounded theoretical 7/13 low-speed drag ratio is 483025/111556≈4.329888, not measured kinetic or UD-specific.
next_discriminant: freeze common 2D PES, contact, loss and pressure response, then test held-out signed force/load residual
